# Native browser payload third-party material

BPMN EOT and SVG font assets match the recorded bpmn-font 0.12.1 hashes.
Its separate SIL OFL 1.1, attribution and exact source binding are preserved
in bpmn-font-0.12.1/. The bpmn-js watermark condition remains separate.

This package embeds Source Han Sans CN and JetBrains Mono original font bytes.
Their original attribution, immutable origins and hashes are recorded in
whiteboard-fonts/manifest.json. Full SIL OFL 1.1 texts are preserved in
whiteboard-fonts/licenses/. No historical Excalidraw font material is included.

BPMN 18.24.0, pako 2.0.3 and DOMPurify 3.4.16 license texts and source
records are provided in the correspondingly named directories. pako includes
its zlib attribution. The existing Lucide materials remain in ../lucide-react/.

This material delivery does not certify complete transitive dependency
coverage, BPMN watermark rendering, or rights to unidentified assets.
The original license texts and source records control their respective terms.
